about: The comparison's time signal as the old path draws and reads it. Recorded from the code before the figure service, which is gone: the file cannot be made again, and stays as the record of what that code answered.

tones.about: Four seconds at 8 kHz (32,000 samples), two channels: 440 Hz and 37 Hz tones under a slow swell, a 4-sample click at 1 s; the second channel is 0.6 of the first (the picture is their average).

buckets.description: 10 samples in 4 buckets (as np.array_split: the first two buckets are one sample longer).
10 samples in 10 buckets (a bucket a sample).
7 samples in 12 buckets (fewer samples than buckets: a bucket a sample).
32000 samples in 1200 buckets (the whole picture's 1200 buckets over 32,000 samples: the first 800 hold 27 samples, the rest 26).

extremes.description: Twelve samples in 4 buckets: each bucket's lowest and highest sample by index; of equal samples the first.
A sample with no value (NaN) counts as both the lowest and the highest of its bucket, so the band is broken there.
More buckets asked than samples: each sample its own bucket.

view.description: The whole picture: the channels averaged sample by sample; a band of 1200 buckets, each its lowest and highest sample at that sample's own time (index / rate); its valueRange is every sample's lowest and highest, and absolutePeak every sample's largest magnitude (the click), not the band's (every 40th bucket and point kept).
view.source: old path: stage_view.py stage_view / _channel_view / samples_waveform / signal_line; stage_combine.py value_range

view.description: Zoomed onto 0.9 … 1.3 s at 600 points: the 3201 samples there in 600 buckets (every 20th kept); its valueRange and peak are of the part on screen.
view.source: old path: stage_view.py _detail_view (signal): index_range, signal_line, samples_waveform

view.description: Zoomed onto 1 … 1.002 s at 600 points: fewer samples than buckets, so every sample is drawn as itself (every one kept): both ends of the range are in.

read.description: A window of 12 samples (1 … 1.001375 s) is sent whole, with one sample past each end: every sample at its own time, its step the sample period.
read.source: old path: stage_combine.py read_points (full_read.read_line / pointer_picks / _seek_line / read_level over the Frame's reading)

read.description: The whole 4 s (32,000 samples) across 60 px with the pointer at 2.0003 s and 0.2 (15 px per second, 200 px per unit, values −1 … 1 shown): too dense to send whole, so per pixel column its lowest and highest sample and the one nearest the pointer's level, the point nearest the pointer on screen, and `under`: the sample nearest the pointer along the axis.
read.source: old path: stage_combine.py read_points (full_read.read_line / pointer_picks / _seek_line / read_level over the Frame's reading)

read.description: The pick window around the pointer on the click, zoomed in (20 px either side of 1.0002 s at 1500 px per second: 0.98687 … 1.01353 s, 213 samples: sent whole).
